verdict.rationale: Vapi documents its own natural-language feature, Composer, which lets you 'describe what you want to build' while it handles the technical setup. Its official MCP server also lets an external AI assistant manage assistants, phone numbers, and calls through conversational prompts. However, Composer appears only as a single one-line mention, and the MCP route depends on a third-party AI client, so full operation of the product by natural language is not shown. Missing for 10: detailed docs on which operations Composer can perform beyond initial setup, evidence of ongoing management (calls, numbers, settings) via natural language inside Vapi itself, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
